subject: Medivia deployment path: security triage and procurement path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medivia.health>, Michael Tran <michael.tran@medivia.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Medivia deployment path: security triage and procurement path

Hi Sarah / Michael —

Great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the procurement/security reviews: 

1) Summary from the call
- Primary objective: integrate Redwood-generated summarization and triage into Medivia's clinician portal.
- Expected data flow: patient notes and structured EHR snippets (PHI) will be sent to inference for short-lived processing; minimal persistence desired.
- Primary compliance drivers: HIPAA with BAA, SOC 2 evidence for data handling, and an audit window for logs and access records.

2) Options we discussed (short tradeoffs)
- Hosted API + BAA: fastest to production; Redwood can sign a BAA and provide SOC2 artifacts. Best if PHI scope is minimized or filtered.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs): predictable performance and logical isolation; logs & tenancy separated; good middle ground for teams wanting stricter isolation without full VPC.
- Private VPC / On-prem: full network isolation and customer-controlled networking; longer setup and procurement; recommended if you need strict network controls or air-gapped operations.

3) Immediate asks from our side (so we can recommend a path):
- Please confirm expected PHI types and whether any full imaging/attachments will flow through the service.
- Clarify your audit window requirement (how far back logs must be retained and what events you need).
- Any mandatory vendor checklist items beyond SOC2/BAA (pen test reports, ISO, specific encryption attestations)?

4) Proposed owners & timeline
- Redwood to share SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, and a draft BAA (attached). Owner: Monica (solutions). Target: EOD today for docs, BAA link for signature by end of week if possible.
- Medivia security to confirm PHI scope and upload vendor questionnaire. Owner: Sarah. Target: 48 hours.
- Follow-up: procurement + security sync next Wednesday (propose 10/14).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf, redwood-arch-vpc-diagram.png, draft-BAA-Redwood-Medivia-20261011.docx

Happy to adjust — I flagged Karthik for any infra-specific questions.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Dr. Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medivia.health>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Medivia deployment path: security triage and procurement path

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. I attached our initial vendor security questionnaire so you can see the gaps we typically need filled. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- PHI scope: primarily clinical notes (free text) and discrete vitals; no DICOM images in the first phase.
- Audit window: security would like 12 months of immutable access logs and a 90-day rolling retention for debug-level traces.
- On-prem: we are evaluating a strict VPC-first requirement for our production tenant but would consider a dedicated capacity approach if we can get the same auditability and contractual assurances. Can Redwood support an on-prem or air-gapped deployment if needed down the road?

Also: do you have references of customers who moved from Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private VPC (sequence and typical timelines)? That would help our procurement team.

Attached: medivia-vendor-questionnaire.pdf

— Sarah
Dr. Sarah Liu
VP, Security & Compliance | Medivia Health
sarah.liu@medivia.health | (617) 555-3344

Sarah / Michael —

Thanks — appreciate the questionnaire, that helps. Below is a concise mapping of what Redwood can provide today and what would require additional lift / timeline.

What we can provide within 24–48 hours:
- SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted) + summary of controls: see attachment redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf.
- Draft BAA ready for review: link to DocuSign (https://app.docusign.com/some-ds-link/BAA-REDWOOD-MEDIVIA) and attached draft-BAA-Redwood-Medivia-20261011.docx.
- Architecture diagrams showing Hosted, Dedicated, and VPC options: attached redwood-arch-vpc-diagram.png.
- Pen-test summary and remediation log (redacted) — we can share within 3 business days with an NDA.

Controls & evidence notes (answers to your questionnaire highlights):
- Data in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced; mutual TLS available for Dedicated and VPC endpoints.
- Data at rest: customer-data keys are AES-256; KMS integration available for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Access controls: RBAC with SSO (OIDC/SAML); audit logs with immutable storage for requested windows.
- Logs/audit window: we can retain access logs for 12 months in Dedicated and Private; hosted tier supports 12-month logs with add-on retention (ops team will confirm SLA).

On on-prem / air-gapped: Redwood supports a Private on-prem deployment model for select enterprise customers. That is a longer engagement (4–8 weeks onboarding/deployment, depending on network and security approvals). Typical sequence for customers we know who moved from Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private: 2–6 months to Dedicated, 3–6 months pilot for Private (procurement & network approvals often drive the timeline). I can share anonymized references — Karthik, would you like those copied?

Recommended next steps (we propose a short sprint to close procurement asks):
- Action: Redwood to upload SOC2 summary + BAA draft to your secure intake (Sarah) by EOD. Owner: Monica.
- Action: Medivia to confirm PHI flow & upload completed vendor questionnaire. Owner: Sarah. Target: 48 hours.
- Action: Schedule procurement + security sync for 10/14 to decide Hosted vs Dedicated pilot (30–90 day pilot). Owner: Aditya / Medivia procurement.

Attachments & docs we shared: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf; redwood-arch-vpc-diagram.png; draft-BAA-Redwood-Medivia-20261011.docx

If helpful, we can also run a short tech deep-dive with our infra engineer (Karthik) to validate mutual-TLS and KMS flows against your environment.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189
